verdict.rationale: Teller is a hosted banking-data API, and self-hosting is a fair openness question for that kind of service, so the axis applies. Every item in the pack describes Teller-operated infrastructure: the API, mTLS client certificates issued by Teller, the Teller Dashboard, and Teller-hosted sandbox environments. Nothing shows a self-hostable or open-source deployment, and one community commenter explicitly wished it were open source.
